sources.title: SAMExporter — Export SAM Models to ONNX - anylabeling.nrl.ai
sources.snippet: SAMExporter — Export SAM Models to ONNX SAMExporter is the tool used to export the Segment Anything family of models into ONNX format for deployment in AnyLabeling and other applications. It supports the full model family: SAM, MobileSAM, SAM2, SAM2.1, and SAM3. GitHub: vietanhdev/samexporter (opens in a new tab)

sources.title: samexporter · PyPI
sources.snippet: Tips Use quantized models (*.quant.onnx) for faster inference and smaller file size with minimal accuracy loss. SAM ViT-B is the fastest SAM1 variant; SAM ViT-H is the most accurate. SAM2 Tiny / SAM2.1 Tiny are good CPU-friendly choices for SAM2. SAM3 is slower due to its three-model pipeline but uniquely supports natural-language object queries.
